title: census.py's LEARN_MAP win32 entry looks up a lower-case path that the mixed-case win32 repository does not hold, so its pages still go to Learn
goal: check_learn finds a windows/win32/ page's file in MicrosoftDocs/win32 when the repository directory differs from the Learn path only in letter case (desktop-src/ADSI for adsi), so detect decides it by git history

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
w = os.path.join(t, 'w')
os.makedirs(os.path.join(w, 'desktop-src', 'ADSI'))
open(os.path.join(w, 'desktop-src', 'ADSI', 'binding-with-encryption.md'), 'w').write('x\n')
for a in (['init', '-q'], ['add', '.'], ['-c', 'user.name=a', '-c', 'user.email=a@corp.example.com', 'commit', '-qm', 'x']):
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', w] + a, check=True)
repo, path = census.learn_source('https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/adsi/binding-with-encryption')
v = census.check_learn(w, path, '2026-01-01')
print(repo, path, v)
sys.exit(0 if v else 1)

notes: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-gavrmuvx on 2026-10-21 (headless reviewer over git diff a4b91d2f1e..ae798b6984), verified by the manager; premise: the repro fails on ae798b6984.
